items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: That happened to be where I met my first wife, Emma... [in the context of Frank Sebastian's club]

ctx.x: Frank Sebastian was a typical Italian, who happened to... I guess he just dug Black musicians, because that was... His house band was a Black band, and that was during a time in history when it really wasn't that popular. He's the one who brought Louis Armstrong to the Coast -- I guess you know that.
